events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. What's your favourite track from that album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing three days of peace and music to upstate New York.

angles.name: Woodstock anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since Woodstock kicked off! Which artist would you have loved to see on that stage?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year. His music lives on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Legendary rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on this day in 1996, following a shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His powerful lyrics continue to resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His guitar genius remains unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most iconic ever, isn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your top tune from him, solo or with Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released the timeless 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly today.

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple unveiled the device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which Bond film or theme tune is your all-time favourite? We're celebrating 64 years since Dr. No premiered.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon birthday tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His musical legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album: 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A truly diverse and groundbreaking record. What are your standout tracks?
